Business information and enquiries

This website provides general information about NBK Diesel Trading LLC and its commercial activities. It is intended to support business enquiries. Website content, a product selection, an email draft or a submitted enquiry is not a binding offer, quotation, reservation, order, acceptance or commitment to supply. No online checkout, payment or order-confirmation facility is provided.

Products and commercial terms

Product names and descriptions indicate areas of commercial interest. They do not establish current stock, guaranteed supply, a fixed price, product origin, grade, technical conformity or suitability for a particular purpose. Product specifications, quantities, quality and inspection documents, origin, availability, price, taxes and charges, delivery arrangements, any applicable Incoterms, payment and other terms must be confirmed in a separate written quotation or agreement by authorised representatives. A signed commercial agreement governs the transaction concerned.

Licensing and transaction checks

A proposed transaction remains subject to the applicable licensing and regulatory requirements, counterparty checks, sanctions, export and import controls, and the laws of the relevant jurisdictions. A product listing is not a certification, regulatory approval or assurance that a specific transaction is permitted. Any required technical, inspection or compliance documentation must be verified for the actual transaction. These notices do not replace the company’s operational or legal obligations.

Photography, films and dynamic graphics

Photography and footage are licensed industry illustrations. They do not represent ownership, operation, control or use by NBK of the vessels, facilities, storage tanks or other assets shown. Brands, locations or organisations visible in media are not represented as NBK customers, partners or endorsers. Animated lines and the enquiry diagram are design and explanatory elements; they are not live market data, shipment tracking, actual transport routes, evidence of completed trades or a representation of NBK’s geographic footprint. See the Media credits for sources and licences.

Email composer and communications

The enquiry form prepares a message locally and requests your chosen email application to open. It does not send the message, confirm delivery to NBK, store the enquiry in an NBK website database or provide a transaction receipt. You must review and send the email yourself. If an email application does not open, use the copy option and email info@nbkdiesel.ae. Ordinary email may not be appropriate for sensitive material; agree a suitable channel before sharing identity documents, banking credentials or confidential transaction documents. The Privacy policy explains the processing relevant to this website and enquiries.

Website information may change, become outdated or contain errors. Seek current written confirmation of information material to a transaction. Access and operation are not guaranteed to be uninterrupted or error-free. Any limitation of liability applies only to the extent permitted by applicable law. Nothing in this disclaimer excludes liability for fraud, fraudulent misrepresentation or any liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, removes mandatory rights, or overrides obligations in a signed commercial contract.

External websites and services operate under their own terms and privacy policies. A link or credit does not constitute a guarantee or endorsement.
